command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$projects=(Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects' -Method Get).name; foreach(`$p in `$projects){`$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/'+`$p+'/nodes/PE1/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString('display current-configuration'); `$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u -Method Get; `$hits=`$r.output -split '\r?\n' | Where-Object {`$_ -match '^ip route-static'}; if(`$hits){Write-Output ('### '+`$p); Write-Output `$hits}}"
